blocks.text: Interior design project for a 43 m² duplex apartment

parts.html: For a 43 m² duplex apartment, the DUMSKAYA DESIGN studio (Bratislava, Slovakia) delivered the full cycle of work: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture manufacturing, and a turnkey renovation. The design covered the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom; furniture designed by the studio was made for each area.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. Below are 3D visualizations, photos, and a video of the finished apartment.
